name: comp-209
blurb: Select field with muted gray background.
description: A select input with a gray background, no border, and no shadow. Uses theme tokens for consistent styling.
use_when: You want a subtle select field that visually recedes from the page.
avoid_when: When you need high contrast or want the field to stand out.
a11y: Uses shadcn Select; label properly associated via htmlFor.
